title: Lag fix, loops everywhere, a cleaner Play screen
thisBuild: Lag: the app now fades out the quietest notes when more than 48 sound at once, instead of piling up to 96. After a hiccup it gives the delay back after 10 clean seconds, not a minute.
Loops from every page: the loop button sits next to the tempo in the top bar. Tap it for A to H. While playing, a pick waits for the bar line (Bar), or switch it to Now.
The Play screen lost its view row. FX is on the bottom bar. Step and Keys modes are gone: the Padiano has a Full size for big keys. My Desk is in Settings, under Play layout, next to View size.
Padiano rows run straight up: the row above starts where the row below ends, no repeated notes.
Pitch wheel: the word under it switches Spring and Stay. Stay keeps the bend where you let go, on the nearest note in the key.
XY setup: each direction has At the start and At the edge, so the whole square can cover just the range you perform with.
FX strip: Faders picks which faders show. Wobble moved into the LFO strip as a preset button.
MIDI map: knobs reach a pad's XY (touch the XY, turn one knob for across, the next for up) and Pad volume (on the map panel).
Bug button: the app can now see the phone's speech service (Android was hiding it), and falls back to Android's on-device one. If neither works it opens the note box and says why.
watch: Play hard for a few minutes, then send a quick note: it now says how many voices were sounding whenever the delay grew. Does the lag still creep?
Tap the bug and talk: does it listen now?
Switch loops while playing: does Bar land cleanly on the next bar?
limits: Lessons that used Keys mode now use the Padiano; tell me if one gets stuck.
Menu then tap, the settings tray and the new LFO strip come in the next build.
I cannot hear the app: whether 48 voices is enough for your playing is for your ears.
